page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the left margin.

main_text.p: Athenienses ac socios apud Corinthum debellasse, audita Æmil. Probus in Agesi- lao. cadaverum multitudine, heu miseram, inquit, Graeciam, quae tot in seipsam viros perdidit, quot satis essent ad Barbaros debellandos. Quod etiam respiciens Episcopus Aturensis Præsentibus Cardinalibus Sourdio & Guisio, aliisque ab ordine ecclesiastico, Zyp. loc. [?]arte ci- tat.ad regem deputatis, serio monuit & rogavit, ut edicta Henrici quarti, & sua prohibitiva duellorum, serio executioni tradi curaret, Ne sicut intra paucum tempus decem millia personarum (qui sanguis utinam super Turcam effusus fuisset; quam non late stagnasset, quam gloriosas segetes produxisset, quam salutarius ecclesię pomeria faecundasset?) mutuae sese internecioni sub dementato honoris titulo dederunt, totiens cum omnibus peccans, cumulum

page.notes: The catchword "pec-" stands below the last line at the right and is a broken word, so it is given as catchword and not in the text. The left-margin note "Zyp. loc." with its second line "arte ci- tat." is hard to read; "arte" is doubtful and marked [?]. The note marks in the text are not visible, so the notes are placed beside the lines where they stand. The word "serio" might be "ferio" in print; it is given as "serio". The running head is "P. VOET" and the page number 254 is printed at the top left.
